bias.en: Bearish · testing the 200-day and Aug 24 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 测试 200 日均线和 8月24日低点

read.en: Intel fell 8.0% on Oct 22 to $85.49, trading between $84.64 and $89.18 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($90.4), 10-day ($95.4), 30-day ($107.6) and 100-day ($106.1) averages and just under the rising 200-day ($85.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram little changed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($97.26), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月22日下跌 8.0%，收于 $85.49，盘中区间 $84.64–89.18，成交量为平均水平的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$90.4）、10 日（$95.4）、30 日（$107.6）和 100 日均线（$106.1）下方，并略低于上行的 200 日均线（$85.6）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图变化不大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$97.26），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The drop broke the $88.8 Oct 20 low, now resistance, and closed on the $85.1 Aug 24 low and the 200-day, with the low briefly under both. Resistance is $85.6 (200-day), then $88.8–90.4 (Oct 20 low, 5-day) and $94.5 (September low). Support is $84.6–85.1, then $81.8 (Jul 29 low). A close below $84.6 would open $81.8; a close above $88.8 would target $90.4–94.5.
read.zh: 股价跌破 10月20日低点 $88.8，该位置转为阻力，收于 8月24日低点 $85.1 和 200 日均线附近，盘中低点曾短暂跌破二者。阻力为 $85.6（200 日均线），其次 $88.8–90.4（10月20日低点、5 日均线）和 $94.5（9 月低点）。支撑为 $84.6–85.1，其次 $81.8（7月29日低点）。若收盘跌破 $84.6，将打开 $81.8；若收盘站上 $88.8，下一目标看 $90.4–94.5。
